input.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of 12 months' payments and USD 1,000,000) to Section 11.5, preserving the existing carve-outs as uncapped.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives indirect damages but contains no aggregate liability cap, so both Parties carry unlimited direct-damages exposure; our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000. The existing clause (A)–(D) carve-outs (fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, Article 9 confidentiality, Section 5.8 exclusivity and indemnification) remain outside the cap, and AbbVie's payment obligations under Article 6 are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.text: Aggregate Cap. Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D) of Section 11.5, for which liability is not capped, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by AbbVie to Harpoon under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) One Million United States Dollars (US$1,000,000). AbbVie's obligation to pay amounts that have become due under Article 6 shall not constitute damages for purposes of, and shall not be subject to or count against, the foregoing cap.
